## Transforms applied

1. **`'use client'` injected per file** where the source uses React state/effects/refs,
   portals, or DOM listeners. Everything else stays a Server Component.
2. **`--via-border-strong` de-duplicated** — upstream declares it twice (a color and a
   `1px solid` shorthand); the color is renamed to `--via-border-strong-color`.

Deliberately NOT applied: no `[data-via-screen]` scoping, no `ViaScreen` wrapper, no
token-file surgery, no dark-block stripping. This project has no legacy styles to leak
into, so base styles are global and `data-theme="light"` is pinned on `<html>`.
